svg.title: From LitVM to Litecoin
svg.desc: Intended V2 route. LitVM: zkLTC. Arbitrum infrastructure: LitVM → Ethereum. Ethereum: zkLTC. Charms integration: Ethereum → Litecoin. Litecoin: Native LTC. Conceptual route, not redemption instructions. Conditions depend on the released integration.

g.aria-label: Conditions depend on the released integration.
